data.action: 半卧竹榻把玩酒葫芦听雨
data.description: 【令 · 岁府闲居听雨】大炎旧宅的檐下回廊，令半卧在铺了软垫的竹榻上，宽松的墨灰家居袍半敞，腰间挂着一只青玉酒葫芦。檐外细雨如帘，她晃着杯中的残酒，懒洋洋地哼起不成调的古谣——「雨打芭蕉，最是催眠。博士若无事，不如也躺下歇一歇。」
data.lighting: soft diffused overcast light, gentle rain haze, warm indoor lamp glow
data.promptProse: Half-reclined on a cushioned bamboo daybed beneath the Sui manor eaves, Ling loosely wears her ink-gray robe and swirls the last wine in her cup, a jade gourd at her sash. The intimate medium view places bamboo slats below her and rain beyond the corridor. Diffuse overcast light softens the open side; an indoor lamp warms the silk cushion and shaded robe folds.
data.title: 令 · 岁府闲居听雨
